notes: Placement: see experiment:na34-helios (generic North Area site).

placements.locator: Hedberg HELIOS page; Greybook: beam H8
placements.note: Generic Prévessin North Area placement (NA = North Area); Greybook gives the beam line H8 but no fetched source names the hall. Dates as for the experiment intervals (inferred).
placements.quote: HELIOS consisted of two fixed-target experiments at the SPS which studied heavy ion collisions (NA34/2) and lepton production in hadronic interactions (NA34/1).

summary.plain: A set of calorimeters wrapped nearly all the way around the target, with silicon trackers and spectrometers, that measured the energy and particles flying out of ion collisions.
summary.technical: HELIOS: uranium/scintillator and uranium/liquid-argon calorimeters covering essentially the complete centre-of-mass solid angle, silicon strip detectors, high-resolution drift chambers, a transition radiation detector (proton set-up), a hadron spectrometer, NaI photon detectors and the NA3 muon spectrometer.

technology.locator: Hedberg HELIOS page, apparatus description (NA34/1 set-up); Specht slides for NA34-2
technology.quote: Essentially the complete centre of mass solid angle was covered by the Uranium/Scintillator and Uranium/Liquid Argon calorimeters.
technology.value: Near-4-pi uranium-scintillator and uranium-liquid-argon calorimetry with silicon detectors, drift chambers, a hadron spectrometer, photon detectors and a muon spectrometer
